app.title: Trustworthy Process Monitor
app.tagline: Data reliability with a human in the loop. Raw data stays on this machine.
status.egressPossible: derived artifacts may leave through the guard
role.pick.title: Who is looking?

role.pick.name: Your name
role.pick.operator: What is wrong, where, what to do, how sure we are.
role.pick.engineer: Adds evidence tables, signal contributions, detector details and relations.
role.pick.reviewer: Adds the decision log, hash-chain verification, egress ledger and overrides audit.
role.hidden: {n} sections are hidden in the {role} view. Switch role to see them.

common.notYet: Not produced for this run yet.
inference.legend: Inferred from evidence, assumed without direct evidence, or uncertain.
decision.question: Question
decision.recorded: Decision recorded in the log as entry {seq}.
decision.override.title: Override {id}
runs.drop: Drop a file here or choose one
runs.orPath: or the path of a file already on this machine
runs.none: No runs yet. Analyse a file to create the first one.
runs.deleteConfirm: Delete run {id} and all its artifacts? The decision log goes with it.
runs.demo: Create a demo run from synthetic data
runs.noRunHint: Select a run in the Runs view first.
runs.dropHelp: Any size: a large file is sent in pieces with a progress screen, and it stays on this machine.
runs.pathHelp: A file given by path is read in place: nothing is uploaded or copied.
runs.selectedOlder: Selected run (older than the five above)
runs.unlockHint: The numbered pages on the left unlock one by one as each step finishes.
upload.title: Uploading {name}
upload.phase.sending: Uploading. You can open other pages meanwhile; the upload continues.
upload.phase.storing: All bytes sent. The file is being stored in the workspace…
upload.inPlace: No upload needed: reading the file in place, nothing is copied.
upload.inPlaceHelp: The file stays where it is on this machine. The analysis reads it from its path and writes only its results into the workspace.
upload.staysLocal: The file stays on this machine: it goes from this browser to the analysis service running here and is stored in its workspace ({dir}). Nothing is sent anywhere else.
upload.staysServer: The file goes only to the analysis server this page was opened from ({host}) and is stored in its workspace ({dir}). It is not sent anywhere else.
upload.cancelTooLate: The file had already arrived and the analysis of {id} has started. Delete that run from the list once it stops.
upload.failed: The upload did not go through:
upload.failedPath: The analysis could not be started:
upload.connectionLost: The connection to the analysis service was lost before the upload finished. Check that the service is still running, then try again.
lock.failed: Nothing to show: the analysis failed at {failed} before {stage} produced this page's data.
lock.failedSelf: Nothing to show: the {stage} step failed before it produced this page's data.
lock.skipped: Nothing to show: {stage} was skipped for this run ({msg}).
lock.title.failed: Nothing to show here: the analysis failed at {failed}
lock.title.skipped: Nothing to show here: {stage} was skipped
lock.body.waiting: {view} shows what the {stage} step produces. The analysis of {run} has not got that far yet. This page opens by itself when it does.
lock.body.failed: {view} needs the output of the {stage} step, which never finished for {run}. Pages whose steps completed before the failure are still open.
lock.body.skipped: {view} needs the output of the {stage} step, and that step did not run for {run}. Reason given: {msg}.
lock.stale: No progress has been recorded for {min} minutes. The analysis may have been interrupted, for example by a restart of the service. If it does not move, start it again from Runs.
und.title: What the system understood about this file
und.sourceName: header in your file (not used for decisions)
und.roleOverrideHelp: Your override is logged and used by later stages.
und.clusters: Clusters of signals that move together
und.pickSignal: Pick a signal in the catalog to see its evidence.
dq.title: Can the data be trusted?
dq.bannerFail: Data cannot be trusted for {signals} in {batches}.
dq.bannerWarn: Data is usable with caution in {n} batches.
dq.bannerOk: All {n} batches pass the trust checks.
dq.rulesIntro: Write a rule the way you would say it. The system compiles it into a check, explains what it understood and how sure it is. Nothing runs before you approve it.
dq.rulePlaceholder: For example: S03 must stay between 100 and 140
mon.title: Drift and anomalies over time
mon.clickFlag: Click a flag marker or row to see its evidence and ask about it.
mon.pointNote: A single reading: onset, pattern and propagation analysis do not apply to it.
mon.focusHelp: The signals around these rows as recorded (raw values, shown only on this machine). The marked band is the row range.
sus.title: Suspicious rows
sus.wordingShort: Glitch or manipulation: the data alone can't tell.
sus.pointLead: Most deviations in this data are isolated single readings, not sustained events.
sus.pointLeadHelp: {points} short spikes against {sustained} sustained events, so the list of suspicious rows comes before the timeline.
sus.strengthHelp: Largest deviation in this row, in multiples of the signal's normal spread (the bar is full at 20×).
sus.plotTitle: The responsible signals around this row (raw, local only)
sus.none: No suspicious rows on this page.
sus.clickHelp: Click a row to see the responsible signals around it and to ask why.
mon.rawSeries: Signals behind this flag (raw, local only)
mon.detectors: Detectors and how they were chosen
diag.title: Diagnoses
diag.pick: Pick a diagnosis to see the full explanation.
ass.title: Is this data fit for its purpose?
ass.chatPlaceholder: Would adding more data help? Which regime is thin?
ass.uploadHelp: Upload a file to estimate what it would add. Nothing is applied without approval.
log.title: Every decision, in order
log.intro: Inferences, flags, checks, rules, model calls and human decisions, hash-chained so that nothing can be altered afterwards without breaking the chain.
log.bad: Chain broken at entry {seq} after {n} good entries.
flow.title: What leaves this machine
flow.noLedger: No model calls recorded for this run.
flow.ext.title: External model use
flow.ext.leadOn: Only rounded summaries with coded sensor names are sent to {model}; your raw data never leaves this machine.
flow.ext.leadOnMore: Never sent: single readings, dates and times, column names, label values, file names. Every number is first rounded to {digits} significant digits. Fable-class models are refused because they keep data for 30 days.
flow.ext.leadOff: Nothing leaves this machine: every explanation is written by the model installed on this computer.
flow.ext.leadOffMore: Want faster answers? Switch to the hybrid profile below. Only rounded summaries with coded sensor names would then go to {model}, numbers rounded to {digits} significant digits. Fable-class models stay refused because they keep data for 30 days.
flow.ext.leadUnusable: Nothing leaves this machine right now: the external model cannot be used, so the local model does all the work.
flow.ext.reason.key: Why: no API key for the external model is set on this computer.
flow.ext.reason.endpoint: Why: the EU profile needs an EU-hosted endpoint, and none is configured.
flow.ext.reason.blocked: Why: the configured model is refused because of its data retention. Choose Sonnet 5 or Opus 5 below.
flow.ext.opusHint: Most thorough, slower and more costly.
flow.ext.modelNote: Fable and Mythos models cannot be chosen: they keep data for 30 days.
flow.ext.modelOffNote: The choice is used only when the active profile allows an external model.
flow.ext.noRun: Select a run to see how many external calls it made.
flow.ext.sanTitle: What the guard changed before sending
flow.ext.sanNone: Nothing was sent from this run, so there was nothing to clean.
flow.ext.sanNote: Counted over {n} payloads that the guard cleared for sending. Numbers with decimals are rounded to {digits} significant digits, column names become codes (S01, S02 ...), and single readings, dates, label values and file names are removed.
flow.ext.bench: Measured speed on the same tasks
flow.ext.ledgerHint: Exactly what was sent, after cleaning, is listed in the egress ledger under the technical analyses.
rep.title: Report
rep.exportHelp: Generated on this machine from the same findings as the report; takes a few seconds for a large run
rep.exportWorking: Generating {what}… the download starts when it is ready.
rep.sendingTo: Preparing the attachments and sending to {to}…
rep.emailHelp: The HTML report is always attached; the PDF and the PowerPoint deck are generated if needed. The e-mail goes out through the mail server set in .env (TPM_SMTP_*), so the report leaves this machine.
rep.generating: Generating the report in {lang}… this takes a few seconds.
rep.llmPending: The report in {lang} is ready and shown below. The language model is still writing its summary (usually under a minute); the preview reloads when it is added.
rep.llmNone: It does not include a model-written summary (the language model is unavailable or did not answer in time); everything else is complete.
rep.failed: The report in {lang} could not be generated:
rep.regenerateHelp: Build the report again from the current artifacts
rep.capped: Large run: the report lists the {shown} most severe of {total} {what}.
chat.title: Ask about it
chat.placeholder: Ask in your own words: why? which sensor? what should I do?
chat.empty: Ask a question, or click any flag to start from its evidence.
stream.title: Live input
stream.replay: Replay this file as a stream
stream.watch: Watch a folder for new files
ref.notFound: {id} was not found in this run.
ref.subject: About
evidence.missing: Evidence {ids} is not in the registry of this run. If the run just finished, reload the page; if it is still processing, wait for it.
evidence.missingAny: {ids} could not be found in this run. If the run just finished, reload the page; if it is still processing, wait for it.
plain.shareHelp: The bars show how much of the deviation each signal accounts for; 100 % would mean a single signal.
mon.scoreHelp: The line is the combined anomaly score of all detectors; the dashed line is the level considered normal. Markers are flags.
dq.trustHelp: Trust score: the share of the data that passed the checks; below the threshold a batch is not used for detection.
dq.pickBatch: Click a bar to see one batch and its checks.
dq.wholeBatchNote: left out or down-weighted in detection for this batch
dq.onlyRows: Unreliable only in these rows (signals affected: {n})
dq.onlyRowsNote: Detection treats these rows as data problems for those signals and trusts the signals everywhere else. A row range opens the Monitor at those rows.
dq.noVerdict: No trust verdict is stored for batch {id}.
dq.batchesAttention: {n} of {total} batches need a look, worst first.
dq.why.unit_shift: scale change, looks like a different unit
dq.why.relation_break: no longer moves with its related signals
dq.checksHelp: Each row is one check on one batch. Click a row to ask about it; ids in the text are links.
diag.why.process: Several related signals moved together and kept their usual relations: the disturbance is in the process, not in one instrument.
diag.why.sensor: One signal broke its usual relation to its partners while the partners stayed consistent: the instrument, not the process, is the likely cause.
diag.why.data: The change is a data artefact (scale, duplicates, gaps), not a physical event.
diag.why.mixed: Both a process disturbance and an instrument problem remain plausible.
diag.why.unknown: The evidence does not favour a process or a sensor explanation.
diag.verdictHelp.supported: The critique found no objection; the confidence stands.
diag.verdictHelp.weakened: The critique raised objections; the confidence was lowered.
diag.verdictHelp.rejected: The critique found the diagnosis unconvincing; treat it as a hypothesis only.
ass.gainHelp: about {n} points more {metric} on a 0–100 scale
ass.scoreHelp: combined from fitness, coverage and data quality
ass.compHelp: Each component is a 0–100 % score; the weight says how much it counts in the combined score.
ass.action.add_more_like: Collect more data of the same kind
ass.learningCurveHelp: How {metric} grows as more of the data is used; a curve still rising means more data would help.
ass.coverageHelp: Share of the data in each operating regime; a thin regime is one the models have rarely seen.
ass.dqHelp: Share of batches passing each family of checks.
ass.diminishing: diminishing returns from {p} of the data
ass.noThin: No thin regime: every operating state is well represented.
ass.recHelp: Each recommendation names its expected effect and evidence. Nothing is applied before you approve it.
ass.chatHelp: Ask in your own words; the answer is built from the numbers above and cites its evidence.
runs.demoStarted: Demo run {id} started on {src}; the real pipeline is running.
brief.techHint: charts, tables, evidence and every number behind this summary
brief.askHint: Opens the chat with this question
brief.unavailable: The short summary is not available right now; the technical analyses are shown below.
brief.topFindingsHelp: Accept, question or override each finding right here. The full reasoning is under “Show technical analyses”.
brief.sus.headline: This reading does not fit its surroundings. It is a glitch or a manipulation; the data alone can't tell.
brief.sus.headlineRows: These readings do not fit their surroundings. They are a glitch or a manipulation; the data alone can't tell.
brief.sus.signal: {name} {dir}: about {x} times more than it normally moves.
brief.sus.decide: Accept, question or correct the alarm
brief.batch.trusted: Nothing to do: these rows passed all checks.
brief.batch.caution: These rows can be used. Only the stretches listed in the technical part are set aside.
brief.batch.untrusted: Do not rely on findings from these rows until the sensors named here have been checked.
